steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject at http://127.0.0.1:8090/ with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password exactly as the literal text '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}'). Then, without modifying them, report the subjects of all work packages in the project 'Bench Project' whose subject starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed.

02-create: In the project 'Bench Project' in OpenProject, create a new work package of type 'Task' with subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}'. While creating it (or immediately after, using the work package's in-place editable fields), set: assignee to the user 'Bench Assignee' (this is an autocomplete — you must actually select the 'Bench Assignee' option from the dropdown, not just type it), status to 'In progress', and finish date to 2026-12-31. Verify each field saved by reopening/reading the work package page, and report the work package's numeric ID as displayed (like #123), the assignee shown, the status shown, and the finish date shown.

03-open: In OpenProject, open work package {{02-create.work_package_id}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project' and add a comment whose text includes the string '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment, then verify it appears in the work package's activity/comments area and report the exact comment text shown and the work package ID.

04-open: In OpenProject, open work package {{02-create.work_package_id}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project' and read-only verify and report: (1) the work package's numeric ID as displayed, (2) its type, (3) its subject, (4) its status, (5) its assignee, (6) its finish date, (7) whether its description contains the text '{{runid}}' and what the description says, and (8) whether there is a comment containing '{{runid}}' and its exact text. Do not change anything.
